paper_title: One Time-traveling Bit is as Good as Logarithmically Many
statement: A very interesting open question left by our work is one also raised at the end of [31]: What is the computational power conferred by 1 time-traveling qubit? Answering this question precisely would seem to require a good understanding of stationary density matrices for 1-qubit quantum channels. As mentioned in Section 1.1, we are not aware of any work showing that time-traveling qubits confer more computational power than time-traveling bits.
